children: BDX Rail AB has appointed NRC Group Machine Sverige AB, a company wholly owned by NRC Group ASA, to a contract for tamping work on the northern and southern sections of the Malmbanan railway line.
The contract is valued at approximately SEK 49 million, and the work will commence immediately and scheduled for completion in November 2029.

Since launching our strategy in 2024, we have added two new reporting segments, Special Operations and Machine, to further strengthen our business platform. The Nordic machine unit is created to support our own operations while positioning in the external market. Securing this first contract is an important proof point. It confirms that we have the expertise, capacity, and competitive edge needed to win and deliver on attractive opportunities to new customers, says CEO Anders Gustafsson, NRC Group ASA
For further information, please contact: Åsgeir Nord, CFO of NRC Group, + 47 957 34 985.

This information is subject to disclosure under the Norwegian Securities Trading Act, §5-12. The information was submitted for publication, through the agency of the contact persons set out above, at 2026-09-11 11:35 CEST.
This stock exchange announcement was published by Charlotte Krog, Communication, NRC Group ASA.

title: NRC Group ASA - Appointed to a machine contract in Sweden - SEK 49 million
